mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 53 degrees at Harriet Park.

The city is highlighting new stormwater and erosion control permit requirements for developers. Additionally, pavement repairs are scheduled for November 9 and 10 on North Nine Mound Road and surrounding streets.

It is a busy week for events. Today, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look out for Trivia Night at the Bogey Factory, Thursday Night Art House, and Hop Haus Trivia.

Regarding local activity, on October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-old juveniles riding e-motorcycles on Ashton Drive and their parents were cited for allowing the operation of a motor vehicle by a minor.
Today is a great day to visit Culver's for the Dark Chocolate PB Crunch flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until 10 PM tonight.
